title: Rule-Admin-System-Settings
description: JSON schema for creating and updating Pega application settings (Rule-Admin-System-Settings). Application settings store per-environment configuration values such as base URLs and authentication profile names. They are referenced by REST connectors via SETTING-based URL and auth profile configuration. On create, omit pySettingMetaData.pyCategoryName unless reusing a category name that already exists — inventing one fails validation.

pyRuleName.description: Internal rule name — auto-derived as 'pyOwner pyPurpose' (e.g., 'Onboarding-Payroll BaseURL'). Do not set directly; supply pyOwner and pyPurpose instead.

pyLabel.description: Display label for the setting, author-supplied. Independent of pyPurpose — a technical pyPurpose (e.g. 'pyBuddyAuthenticationProfile') may pair with a human-readable pyLabel (e.g. 'Buddy Authentication Profile').

pyOwner.description: Owning context for the setting, typically '{Application}-{IntegrationSystem}' (e.g. 'Onboarding-Payroll'). Distinct from pyRuleSet (the actual ruleset, e.g. 'Onboarding').

pyPurpose.description: The setting name within the owner context, e.g. 'BaseURL' or 'AuthProfile'. Never blank in practice.

pyRuleSet.description: Ruleset containing this setting. Auto-derived to the branch ruleset.

pyProductionLevel.description: Array of 5 environment-tier entries. Each entry holds the setting value for that tier in pySetting. pyDescription values: '1 - Sandbox', '2 - Development', '3 - Quality assurance', '4 - Staging', '5 - Production'.

pySettingMetaData.description: Metadata about the setting including value type and category.

pyCategoryName.description: Category grouping for the setting. Validated server-side against existing category records — omit this field on create unless reusing the exact name of a category that already exists (e.g. one created by recipe-create-data-type-with-generator); an unrecognized name fails create with 'Selected category is invalid.'

pyValueType.description: Data type of the setting value. Matches the Application Setting UI's 'Value type' dropdown exactly (String/text, Boolean, Enumerated list = 'Enum', Class). 'Class' is used for auth profile references, where the value is an authentication profile name and pyValueClass names the target class.

pyValueClass.description: Required companion to pyValueType: 'Class' — the class the setting's value should resolve to. Confirmed live: 'Data-Admin-Security-AuthenticationProfile' for auth profile settings.

EnvironmentTier.description: A single environment tier entry holding the setting value for that environment.

pyDescription.description: Environment tier label, e.g. '1 - Sandbox', '2 - Development', '3 - Quality assurance', '4 - Staging', '5 - Production'.

pyLabel.description: Optional display label for this tier entry.

pySetting.description: The actual setting value for this environment tier. This is the field to update.
